label: Letters 1: alif to sad
desc: The first 14 letters, alif to ṣād, with their sounds and families.

label: Letters 2: dad to ya
desc: The last 14 letters, ḍād to yāʾ.

label: Vowels and marks
desc: Short and long vowels, sukun, shadda, tanwin, hamza, ة, ى, and ال with sun and moon letters.

label: Sound pairs
desc: Words that differ only in a sound English speakers merge: q / k, ṣ / s, ṭ / t, ʿ / ʾ, ḥ / h, kh / ḥ, short / long, single / doubled.

label: Greetings and courtesy
desc: Hello, thank you, please, sorry, goodbye: the phrases MSA shares with everyday speech.

label: About me
desc: Your name, where you're from, where you live, what you do.

label: Family and people
desc: Family members and people, with my / your.

label: Numbers and money
desc: Numbers 0–100, the Eastern Arabic digits, prices and currencies.

label: Food and drink
desc: Coffee, tea, food, ordering and paying.

label: Home and things
desc: Rooms and everyday objects; "I have"; the and a.

label: Describing things
desc: Adjectives in pairs, with agreement.

label: Daily routine
desc: Everyday verbs in the present, and word families.

label: Time and days
desc: Today, tomorrow, yesterday, days of the week, and the past.

label: Around town and directions
desc: Asking the way: where, right, left, near, far.

label: Travel and help
desc: Airport, hotel, transport, and asking for help.

label: Spoken Arabic
desc: The MSA word, and what you'll hear instead in Egypt and the Levant (recognition only).

label: Traps for English speakers
desc: Calques, false friends and courtesy traps.

label: Compliments
desc: Everyday praise: food and the cook, work and effort, someone's home, the learner's Arabic, and how people answer (with the blessing phrases).

label: Flirting
desc: Words people flirt with, the phrases built from them, then moves and replies, including kind ways to say no. Mostly indirect, as in real life.

label: Top nouns
desc: The most-used nouns, with gender and the plural where it changes inside.

label: Top verbs
desc: The most-used verbs by their past "he" form, with the "I" form of the present.

label: Top adjectives
desc: The most-used adjectives, with the feminine form.

label: Top adverbs
desc: Time, place, manner and degree: very, only, also, maybe, soon.

label: Top pronouns
desc: I, you, he, she, the possessive endings, this and that, and some, every, nobody.

label: Top prepositions
desc: In, from, to, with, before, after, and the forms with endings: for me, with you, I have.

label: Top conjunctions
desc: And, or, but, because, if, when, that, so.

label: Top interjections
desc: What people really exclaim: oh, ouch, wow, congratulations, oh my God.

label: Top words
desc: Small words that fit no other class: no, will, did not, numbers to twenty, ordinals, days.
